undeclared.why_it_matters: An A-only failed case with no initial scanner finding cannot use the proposed feedback condition. This is a meaningful scope restriction missing from FL-006/FL-008 and the run instructions.
undeclared.recommended_resolution: Declare the substantive-D prerequisite if intended. Include learned_review in the empty-report error guidance so the user knows which condition prevents launch; no new retrieval machinery is required.

defects.title: Optional lesson-store errors break ordinary experiment reads and evaluation responses
defects.trigger: A lessons/l-*.json file is malformed, unreadable, or lacks fields accessed by list_lessons. Every file is parsed before case filtering, so an unrelated broken lesson is sufficient.
defects.observed: A temporary fixture with a learned lesson replaced by the text { caused Workbench.read on an ordinary review experiment to raise JSONDecodeError. Workbench.list returned zero records. evaluate_manifest caught extraction failure and wrote learning-error.json, but public evaluate then raised the same error from self.read.
defects.score_effect: Saved evaluation bytes stayed unchanged. This is an availability/API regression and incomplete sidecar fault isolation, not evidence that numeric outcomes were rewritten.
defects.recommended_fix: Isolate failures loading optional lesson cards from core experiment read/list/evaluate responses. Expose a clear lesson-loading error while preserving experiment state. Explicit learned_review preparation may reject an invalid store; do not silently reinterpret corruption as proof that no lesson exists.
defects.verification: Reproduced with the existing FailureLearningTests temporary fixture, mocked evaluator return, and no model execution.

defects.title: Unexpected extraction exceptions escape the best-effort evaluation sidecar
defects.trigger: Adverse saved-artifact shape: oracle/stdout.json contains valid JSON [] while the saved summary still records a calibrated scored failure.
defects.observed: learn raises AttributeError at outcome.get. evaluate_manifest catches OSError/ValueError/KeyError/TypeError only, so the error escapes and no learning-error.json is recorded.
defects.scope_qualification: This is an archive-adversity/fault-injection check. The current trusted case evaluator normally validates oracle objects and is not claimed to emit this malformed shape.
defects.recommended_fix: Validate loaded object shapes or catch ordinary Exception at the optional learning boundary, while preserving the saved summary and not catching BaseException. Keep error recording best-effort.
defects.verification: Direct temporary-fixture reproduction printed AttributeError and learning-error sidecar false; no model execution.
